class SurveillanceCameraConsumer(WebsocketConsumer):
    def connect(self):
        self.camera_id = self.scope['url_route']['kwargs']['camera_id']
        self.camera = SecurityCamera.objects.get(id=self.camera_id)
        self.accept()
        self.stream_active = True
        self.start_streaming()
diagnosis: In connect(), the consumer loads SecurityCamera by camera_id directly from the URL route kwargs and begins streaming live video. It lacks an authorization check against self.scope['user'], allowing any authenticated user to view private surveillance feeds.
